nodes.name: Athisa
nodes.summary: Cleric and scholar. Orphan raised by clerics; currently experiencing a crisis of faith. Carries a letter from a dead colleague whose contents weigh on her.

nodes.name: Sparkle Flame-Eater
nodes.summary: High Elf Wizard and exiled royalty. Her homeland Alluria was lost to betrayal. She carries a flame-etched pendant — the only thing left of her kingdom. Recently drew the Throne card from the Deck of Many Things, legally making her the owner of a lost kingdom.

nodes.name: Vaelios
nodes.summary: Warlock whose patron is the Raven Queen. Attended the Gaunting Necromancer Academy. Possesses a dark metal ring with an opal stone that whispers and channels magic. Known by the nickname 'Vael'.

nodes.name: Juliette Vaelith-Robespierre
nodes.summary: Half-Elf Monk, 6'2". Nicknamed 'Robes' (she dislikes it). Her parents own a failed vineyard called Elaria's Cask. Mentored by Grand Monk Jean-Paul Dain. Must earn glory and renown to be named heir by her grandmother Ithiriel Vaelith. Her missing ex-lover Fjord (a half-giant) is somewhere unknown.

nodes.name: Odvar Finch
nodes.summary: Merchant in Bryn Shander who runs the magic emporium 'Finch's Findings.'

nodes.name: Mirelda Wester
nodes.summary: Wrote a letter to Harbin warning about the increasing giant attacks on trade routes. The party needs to meet her at Council Hall in Bryn Shander.

nodes.name: Harbin Wester
nodes.summary: Townmaster of Phandalin. Mirelda Wester's brother. Arranged for the party to travel north to Bryn Shander.

nodes.name: Duvessa Shane
nodes.summary: Speaker of Bryn Shander — effectively the town's leader and political authority.

nodes.name: Augrek Brighthelm
nodes.summary: Red-haired Sheriff's Deputy in Bryn Shander. Greeted the party at the town gates.

nodes.name: Jean-Paul Dain
nodes.summary: Grand Monk and Juliette's mentor.

nodes.name: Ithiriel Vaelith
nodes.summary: Juliette's grandmother. Has set a test for Juliette: earn glory and renown to be named heir to the Vaelith family.

nodes.name: Fjord
nodes.summary: Half-giant and Juliette's missing ex-lover. Whereabouts currently unknown.

nodes.name: Esmeralda
nodes.summary: An ancient, blindfolded seer and Servant of the Deck of Many Things. Her tent has since disappeared.

nodes.name: The Raven Queen
nodes.summary: A powerful entity who serves as Vaelios' patron. She governs death and fate.

nodes.name: Zhentarim
nodes.summary: A shadowy merchant organization with agents across the region. Peaches is a former operative.

nodes.name: Bryn Shander
nodes.summary: The largest of the Ten Towns in Icewind Dale. The party's current location. Home to Finch's Findings, the Council Hall, and several key NPCs.

nodes.name: Actaeon
nodes.summary: An elderly orc paladin encountered at a roadside shrine on the journey north toward Icewind Dale. He joined the party as a fellow traveler and was forced into a desperate battle against an Avatar of Death after drawing from the Deck of Many Things.

nodes.name: Logan
nodes.summary: Sparkle's familiar, a fly, used to scout the mysterious purple tent belonging to Esmeralda before the party entered.

nodes.name: Deck of Many Things
nodes.summary: A legendary and dangerous magical artifact offered by Esmeralda for one hundred gold pieces per draw. The deck bestowed wild fortunes and disasters upon the party, including a Staff of Fire and the promise of a kingdom for Sparkle, Avatars of Death for Sparkle and Actaeon, and the loss of Vaelios's soul to the Void card.

nodes.name: Phandalin
nodes.summary: The town from which the party set out at the beginning of their journey north toward Icewind Dale.

nodes.name: Icewind Dale
nodes.summary: The frozen frontier region north of the Spine of the World that the party is traveling toward. Refugees are fleeing south from it, and rumors of giant attacks trouble the region.

nodes.name: Spine of the World
nodes.summary: A mountain range whose looming peaks mark the threshold between the south and Icewind Dale, visible as the party traveled north.

nodes.name: House of the Triad
nodes.summary: A religious location noted by the party as worth visiting within the walls of Bryn Shander.

nodes.name: Finch's Findings
nodes.summary: A magic shop in Bryn Shander run by Odvar Finch. The party traded unusual curiosities here for gold and magical supplies.

nodes.name: Lords' Alliance
nodes.summary: The Lord's Alliance is a coalition of cities, nobles, and leaders dedicated to maintaining order and stability throughout the Sword Coast. While united by common goals, the alliance is often shaped by the competing interests and ambitions of its influential members.

nodes.name: Asmodeus
nodes.summary: A devil of the seven hells hunting Juliette after she drew the Flames card from the Deck of Many Things.

nodes.name: Sildar Hallwinter
nodes.summary: A member of the Lords' Alliance in Phandalin. Originally helped the party reopen the Lost Mine of Phandelver and helped to slay Cryovain the White Dragon at Icespire Peak

plots.title: The Giant Threat
plots.summary: Giant attacks are increasing across Icewind Dale. Caravans are missing, farms destroyed, and even veteran traders are skipping their northern runs this season. Something has changed in the giants' hierarchy — the party must meet Mirelda Wester at Council Hall to learn more.

plots.title: Raven Queen's Order
plots.summary: The Raven Queen has ordered Vaelios to kill Odvar Finch, whose soul has evaded its natural death and is owed to the Nine Hells. She threatens to revoke his undead companions if he refuses. Vaelios has not yet acted. Complications: killing Finch may trigger a conflict between the Hells and the Raven Queen, and the party loses their magic item vendor.

plots.title: Zhentarim Recruitment
plots.summary: The Zhentarim reached out to Sparkle in Elvish, claiming to know who destroyed her homeland Alluria and what was taken. They offer recognition, revenge, and power — but want a demonstration of her intentions. Her first contact is Kella Darkhope in Bryn Shander, posing as a traveling monk. A postscript noted they are already watching her.

plots.title: Juliette's Inheritance Quest
plots.summary: Juliette's grandmother Ithiriel Vaelith demands she earn glory and renown before being acknowledged as heir. Her father is dead, her mother dying, and the family vineyard Elaria's Cask has failed. She is also searching for her missing ex-lover Fjord, a half-giant last known to be somewhere in the north.

plots.title: Sparkle's Lost Kingdom
plots.summary: Sparkle drew the Throne card from the Deck of Many Things, making her the legal owner of a lost kingdom. She must find and reclaim it. This intertwines with the Zhentarim's offer — they claim to know who destroyed her homeland Alluria and what was taken from it.

plots.title: Athisa's Faith Crisis
plots.summary: Athisa is an orphan raised by clerics who is experiencing a deep crisis of faith. She carries a letter from a dead colleague whose contents weigh on her. She drew the Moon card from the Deck of Many Things, gaining three Wish spells — and used one to restore Vaelios's soul after he drew the Void card, an act of profound faith tested in a moment of chaos.
